Lean.getConstInfo.code: Lean.getConstInfo {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] [MonadError m] (constName : Name) : m ConstantInfo
Lean.getConstInfo.fullDefinition: def getConstInfo [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] [MonadError m] (constName : Name) : m ConstantInfo := do   match (← getEnv).find? constName with   | some info => pure info   | none      => throwError "unknown constant '{mkConst constName}'"
Lean.getConstInfo.description: An operation that retrieves information about a constant from a monadic environment that supports both state management and error handling.

Lean.isRec.code: Lean.isRec {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] (declName : Name) : m Bool
Lean.isRec.fullDefinition: def isRec [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] (declName : Name) : m Bool :=   return isRecCore (← getEnv) declName
Lean.isRec.description: A function that checks if a given declaration is recursive within a monadic environment that manages state.

Lean.mkConstWithLevelParams.code: Lean.mkConstWithLevelParams {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] [MonadError m] (constName : Name) : m Expr
Lean.mkConstWithLevelParams.fullDefinition: def mkConstWithLevelParams [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] [MonadError m] (constName : Name) : m Expr := do   let info ← getConstInfo constName   return mkConst constName (info.levelParams.map mkLevelParam)
Lean.mkConstWithLevelParams.description: An operation that constructs a constant expression with level parameters from a monadic environment that supports state management and error handling.

Lean.getConstInfoDefn.code: Lean.getConstInfoDefn {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] [MonadError m] (constName : Name) : m DefinitionVal
Lean.getConstInfoDefn.fullDefinition: def getConstInfoDefn [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] [MonadError m] (constName : Name) : m DefinitionVal := do   match (← getConstInfo constName) with   | ConstantInfo.defnInfo v => pure v   | _                       => throwError "'{mkConst constName}' is not a definition"
Lean.getConstInfoDefn.description: An operation that retrieves the definition value associated with a constant in a monadic environment that allows for state management and error handling.

Lean.getConstInfoRec.code: Lean.getConstInfoRec {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] [MonadError m] (constName : Name) : m RecursorVal
Lean.getConstInfoRec.fullDefinition: def getConstInfoRec [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] [MonadError m] (constName : Name) : m RecursorVal := do   match (← getConstInfo constName) with   | ConstantInfo.recInfo v => pure v   | _                      => throwError "'{mkConst constName}' is not a recursor"
Lean.getConstInfoRec.description: An operation that retrieves recursive value information associated with a constant in a monadic environment that allows for state management and error handling.

Lean.getConstInfoInduct.code: Lean.getConstInfoInduct {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] [MonadError m] (constName : Name) : m InductiveVal
Lean.getConstInfoInduct.fullDefinition: def getConstInfoInduct [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] [MonadError m] (constName : Name) : m InductiveVal := do   match (← getConstInfo constName) with   | ConstantInfo.inductInfo v => pure v   | _                         => throwError "'{mkConst constName}' is not a inductive type"
Lean.getConstInfoInduct.description: An operation that retrieves the inductive value information associated with a constant in a monadic environment that allows for state management and error handling.
